short_title: Behested payment reporting: payments from donor advised funds
what_it_requires: An elected officer or PUC member filing a Form 803 behested-payment report for a payment from a DAF must name the sponsor, the fund (or 'anonymous donor advised fund') and the donor/advisor (or 'anonymous donor'), with a duty to inquire of the sponsor and to amend within 10 days; sets single-source rules for the $5,000 threshold. Uses §4966(d) definitions
notes: Filed 2021-11-22; operative 2021-12-22 (history note). Binds officials not sponsors; sponsors may withhold names

short_title: Data and trends for DAF/proceeding/relationship disclosure

notes: Coverage window of the data is set out in the memo

what_it_requires: Donor (or legal representative) may sue a charity for declaratory/injunctive relief over violation of a donor-imposed restriction in an endowment agreement; 'endowment fund' = institutional fund not wholly expendable; no damages; no return of gift
